intent: Three deliverables named up front; the user re-prioritizes one mid-conversation; the other two must not be dropped because attention shifted.
prompt: Three things: the rate limit in config/api-limits.md, the read timeout in config/timeouts.md, and max retries in config/retries.md.

followups.prompt: Actually the rate limit is the urgent one — confirm that value for me first.
Thanks. Now give me all three values together in one message.

note: Pass = all three values reported on the final turn. Fail = the timeout or retries value dropped because the mid-conversation re-prioritization narrowed focus to the rate limit and never widened back out.
